articleTitle: Home automation using edge computing and Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: The current smart home ecosystem is fragmented due to competing IoT standards, heterogeneous devices and non-interoperability of home automation solutions. This paper proposes a harmonized and interoperable home automation solutions exploiting the concepts of Edge Computing, Virtual IoT Devices (VID) and the Internet of Things (IoT). We present a smart home architecture, prototype and its application in an use case. Our efforts establish the prototype as a lightweight and secure solution for emerging smart homes.

articleTitle: Application of swarm intelligence in Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: This paper looks into application of swarm intelligence (SI) in the Internet of Things (IoT). SI algorithms are well established and applied in well known problems. The IoT processes being data intensive, the quality of IoT services depend a lot on IoT data processing capabilities. With diverse variety and volume of IoT data, SI algorithms like Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) can play an important role in optimizing the IoT processes. We envision the application of ACO in three IoT domains and outline how they can be improved with the same.

articleTitle: Monitoring daily fitness activity using accelerometer sensor fusion
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: The advancement of sensing technology offers a platform to monitor our daily fitness activity in real time environment situations. The introducing of the wearable sensing device provides an opportunity to monitor and analyze the amount of daily fitness activity conducted. An accelerometer sensor embedded in the wearable device is used to sense the activity vibration. However, recognition performance is significantly correlated with the sensor placement. Hence, the sense from various sensor placements is fused to enhance the recognition performance. In this paper, physical activity monitoring is proposed by integrating the acceleration signal from various sensor placements. The amount of fitness activity could be monitored and analyzed by extending the internet connection linked with the wearable device. Thus, this system could extensively deploy for everyone who are looking for having a better lifestyle.

articleTitle: A design for high speed leading-zero counter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: Leading-zero counter (LZC) is a basic component in floating point operation. This paper aims at speeding up the operation of LZC. Based on new derived Boolean functions and complex logic gates, 8-bit LZC circuit is accomplished. Moreover, 16-bit LZC architecture is implemented in Xilinx field-programmable gate array (FPGA) and 32-bit LZC structure is realized on the platform of Application Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC) in 65nm technology. Synthesis results are obtained on their special platforms. By comparison, our proposed design is faster than the reported designs.

articleTitle: Multi-resident activity recognition using label combination approach in smart home environment
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: Activity recognition in smart home environment is becoming challenging when it is involving more than one resident living in the same space. It is not merely recognizing the activity performed nevertheless to track and identify the performer of specific activity also need to address in order to provide the great autonomous for ambient intelligence system (Ami). It is a challenging task due to diversity and complexity of sensor fusion that only using the binary data from single type technology of ambient sensors. Strong approach is needed to identify types of activities performed at the same time to track which resident are performing that particular activity. Previously, researchers build the multi-resident activity model regardless the performer, thus the data association also fails to tackle the problem applicably. This research presents the multi-label classification approach to recognize the activity at the same is able to track the resident in multi-resident in a smart home setting. It has been tested on the real smart home datasets using Label Combination method of multi-label classification technique using random forest as its base classifier. The Hamming score, accuracy and exact match are selected as evaluation metrics to measure the proposed solution.

articleTitle: Implementation of efficient method of RSA key-pair generation algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: As one of the international public-key cryptographic standards, RSA is widely used in Smart IC card which is in the context of such a large number of users. The RSA key-generation inside the card IC is the most time-consumption procedure during the mass production of the cards. To reduce the time complexity, an optimized RSA key generation algorithm is proposed in this paper. The optimized algorithm was implemented to generate RSA key pairs based on the smart card chip called THD88. Experiments show the time to generate a 1024-bits RSA key-pair is 4.76 seconds on average under the system clock frequency of 20MHz, and is much less than other similar products. Testing results show that the time-consumption distribution fits 3 sigma distribution, and meets the requirements of the engineering application as well.

articleTitle: On service security analysis for event log of IoT system based on data Petri net
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has bridged our physical world to the cyber world which allows us to achieve our desired lifestyle. However, service security is an essential part to ensure that the designed service is not compromised. In this paper, we proposed a security analysis for IoT services. We focus on the context of detecting malicious operation from an event log of the designed IoT services. We utilized Petri nets with data to model IoT service which is logically correct. Then, we check the trace from an event log by tracking the captured process and data. Finally, we illustrated the approach with a smart home service and showed the effectiveness of our approach.

articleTitle: On modeling and simulation of the behavior of IoT malwares Mirai and Hajime
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: Nowadays, IoT malwares are becoming a general threats. Typical examples are Mirai and Hajime. Recently, the battle between these two Malwares attracted attention. First, we modeled Mirai to infect IoT devices. Three patterns of simulation were performed while changing the frequency of reboot. As a result, it proved that infection rate decreases as reboot frequency increases. Next, We modeled the infection of Mirai and Hajime on the devices, the change in state of internal malware and device when infected. In that model, simulation was performed into two situations with different network topologies, and proved that the network topology affects the infection rate of Mirai.

articleTitle: Smartphone accessible agriculture IoT node based on NFC and BLE
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: The smartphones play an Important part In agriculture service today. A smartphone accessible agriculture IoT node is presented in this paper. This node is designed for sightseeing agriculture and education agriculture services. Nodes can meet the needs of in-field farm services as well as the demand of centralized management. The hardware structure of the node and the design of the Android App are discussed. This node is expected to provide new technologies and business supports for smart agriculture.

articleTitle: Real-time PPG monitoring system for mobile healthcare devices
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: The health monitoring system (HMS), which advices user's health condition, have emerged with wearable devices. This work describes the real-time heart rate monitoring system-on-chip architecture for healthcare device. For system efficiency, we chose a processor without any floating-point unit (FPU). Instead, a signal processing that requires high accuracy is replaced with hardware accelerators.

articleTitle: Wi-Fi TDoA indoor localization system based on SDR platform
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: With the overwhelming surge in position and context-aware applications, indoor localization has attracted tremendous attention in recent years. In this paper, we present an enhanced Time Difference of Arrival (TDoA) approach based on RSS-assisted Cross-correlation (RACC) method to mitigate the effect of multipath interference. Then, an integrated localization prototype implemented on Software Defined Radio (SDR) platform is constructed for validation of RACC. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed system achieves decimeter range localization precision, providing a promising solution for tracking electronic terminals.

articleTitle: Enhancing indoor positioning service for location based Internet of Things (IoT): A source selecting approach with error compensation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: This paper presents an enhanced model to handle the radio-frequency (RF) signal to provide a real-time indoor localization service in a practical manner. This model is using the Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) beacons as the RF signal for indoor localization service. The fingerprinting approach, Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) is used to cut-down the cost of implementation and the accuracy can be further improved with more BLE beacons installed. The RSSI technique applied will be further improved with signal selecting algorithm to determine the right reference points for positioning service. An error compensation algorithm also will be applied to eliminate the false signal which will affect the system's accuracy. This proposed model includes implementation of enhanced RSSI technique with error compensation algorithm to determine the position of users or targeted objects with correct reference points to improve the positioning result.

articleTitle: Asymmetrie Kernel Convolutional Neural Network for acoustic scenes classification
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: In this work, we propose an Asymmetric Kernel Convolutional Neural Network (AKCNN) for Acoustic Scenes Classification (ASC). Its kernel shape is not the traditional square but asymmetric in width and height. It also uses Weight Normalization (WN) to accelerate the training process because it can early converge the training loss and accuracy. The best of all, WN can help increase the accuracy of ASC. TUT Acoustic Scenes 2016 Dataset [1] is used for evaluation. The result shows that AKCNN achieves accuracy 86.7%. If we rank the score in DCASE2016 ASC Challenge, it shows that the system would have a higher score than the 5th place.

articleTitle: A design of patients data transparency in electronic health records
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: Healthcare organizations process an enormous amount of patient medical data in the ubiquitous environment. Patient privacy and security is a major challenge in handling a variety of complex data. A wide array of information security mechanisms such as access control, cryptography techniques, auditing, anomaly detection etc. are available to protect from malicious users. Access control policy in Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems should allow doctors to override the healthcare institution's policy and patient consent during an emergency situation. EHR systems collect individual activities of the users in the form of access logs that can be used to detect deviation and verify compliance. Patients have the right to know who accessed their data and for what purpose. We propose a generic cloud based patient data transparency framework that can be achieved through analyzing log events generated from EHR along with records of the patient's consent.

articleTitle: On supervisor synthesis theorem and its application to embedded systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: Embedded systems must be improved to survive in the rapid-changing business environment. Supervisory control is a promising approach for such improvement. This paper presented the introduction of supervisory control theory to embedded systems. The major results are (i) a theorem for supervisory control and (ii) its property which enables us to apply model checking technique to the analysis of the model given by the theorem. They were illustrated with an example of car controller.

articleTitle: Earthquake monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: Earthquake monitoring system was developed to give a freedom for civilian to monitor the recent activity of the earthquake and be alerted with the upcoming earthquake. Node-Red is used as the programming tool of this project. The data from webserver of European Mediterranean Seismological Centre (EMSC) will be sent to Node-Red software and a newsfeed of the recent earthquake activities will be updated. From the newsfeed, data will be analyze and visualize directly via google map and GIANT platform.

articleTitle: Merit2U: An IoT-based merit point management system for university students' hostel application
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: Merit2U is a web-based system to manage merit points for students' college application. This system provides better merit point management where the points are calculated automatically and electronically using web-based application.

articleTitle: Risk transfer mechanism to defend DDoS attacks in IoT scenario
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: Along with the advancements of Internet of Things, the security challenges have also escalated at an alarming rate. The recent increase in DDoS attacks involving IoT-enabled systems has created a lot of disturbances in the digital world. Defending DDoS attacks in the IoT environment is a difficult but essential task. Even though there is some progress being made to create secure IoT systems, due to the resource-constrained nature of IoT devices, there can be instances that large-scale attacks can't be handled by the network. In such cases, a third party can be asked to handle the risk. Such risk transfer mechanism can be constructed on an economic incentive-based agreement. We are modeling a risk transfer mechanism for an IoT environment to defend large DDoS Attacks.

articleTitle: Multimodal decomposition with magnification on micro-expressions and its impact on facial biometric recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: With the advancement of computer vision techniques, genuine human emotions may be captured in split second of facial muscle movements despite of cheating and concealment. These movements are called the micro-expressions. In recent, the study of micro-expressions had been extensively done as research have shown its usefulness in lie detection and clinical diagnosis. Due to its low intensity, sparse and short duration nature, boosting and magnification have applied aiming to improve detection and recognition of micro-expressions. In this paper, we present method to magnify intensity of micro-expressions which inclusive study of its impact on facial biometric recognition.

articleTitle: Fuzzy logic predictive method for indoor environment parametric dataset
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: An environment becomes polluted and contaminated because of excessive construction which taking places in several urban area and this affects the overall air quality index. Indoor air quality index seems much poor than outdoor air quality index because contaminated gases trapped within indoor environment. This research implements the fuzzy logic method to predict ambient temperature of indoor office environment. The temperature data collected previously used as default point of reference for predicting the temperature of the next day. Temperature prediction is necessary to maintain good health from contiguous disease. The research prototype uses the IEEE 802.14.5 wireless device to send temperature data to remote base station. The standard deviation and mean show the correlation between all the collected data. The temperature data is harvested from three different zones in an office for five consecutive days to predict the temperature. As a result, fuzzy logic predicts expectedly for a small dataset but alternative approach needed for a larger dataset, preferably machine learning will be a good choice in cloud service for predicting indoor environment.

articleTitle: De-warping of camera captured document images
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: De-warping is the elementary step in the analysis of document images which are camera based. Processing of warped image is a challenging task. Therefore, to make the document images OCR understandable de-warping has become a major task. In this paper, we have presented camera based document image De-warping technique based on curved text-line information. The process starts with calculating axis x-line using coupled-snake model. Curved text-lines of warped image is used to calculate initial point of neighboring straight text-line in the de-warped image. Curved x-line, base-line pair of every character is mapped to its respective straight x-line. Base-line pair is to remove geometric distortion. Finally, perspective distortion is removed by using four-point homo-graphy algorithm. Proposed De-warping technique is less sensitive in different line spacing, different angle and in different direction of the curve. Experimental results are carried out on IUPR dataset of camera captured documents CBDAR2007, CBDAR2011 & also on our own dataset that consists of Kannada Handwritten documents. The results are encouraging.

articleTitle: Security of a robust transcoding-resistant watermarking for H.264 standard
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: The H.264 standard is widely deployed for high-quality consumer video applications such as DVD and HD video on the internet. In current times where videos are easily shared live on social media and messaging mobile Apps, consumers need to be able to determine the ownership of these videos against being illegally distributed without proper acknowledgements to the source, as well as take actions against those who spread false videos. Robust watermarking schemes are popularly applied techniques to solve these problems. These types of schemes need to achieve robustness against modification attacks on the embedded watermark. In this paper, we focus on a recent robust watermarking scheme and analyse its robustness. We present attacks that enable malicious buyers to modify the watermarks embedded by the owner.

articleTitle: Performance study and analysis of D-SWAP for mobile communication networks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: For newly emerging multimedia applications in mobile communication networks, because their network traffic patterns are different from the traditional applications, some existed power-saving mechanisms in literatures cannot provide better performance on mobile devices anymore. In this paper, a mathematical analysis model is developed to demonstrate the performance of the newly proposed D-SWAP power-saving mechanism. The analyzed performance focuses on the average power consumption and average packet delay. The analysis and simulation results demonstrate that the proposed D-SWAP can concurrently satisfy the trade-off requirements of low average power consumption and low average packet delay.

articleTitle: Analysis framework for H.264/AVC authentication
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: We focus on the security of authenticating H.264/AVC, which is a standard for high definition (HD) video in many consumer applications including DVD movies as well as HD videos shared by users on the internet. There is high risk that these kinds of videos could be modified without authorization, to reflect situations that may not have actually happened, leading to viral videos. To prevent this, video content authentication can be used to detect any such changes. In order to analyze the security of video authentication, we present an attack strategy based analysis framework which applies to watermarking based authentication schemes. With this strategy, we analyze the security of two schemes against modification attacks, i.e. the watermarked video can be modified such that it still passes the recipient's video authentication check. We then discuss the reasons behind why certain attack steps can or cannot be performed by the attacker.

articleTitle: Extraction and improvement of IoT service gap between design and operation based on net model
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: The demands towards IoT services tend to emerge gradually according to market changes. Thus it is necessary to grasp the gap between the service design and operation. In this paper, we first defined the gap between IoT service design and operation. Next, we proposed a method to extract the gap. This method has two key points. The first is to use not the whole but the majority of the operation by using process mining technique. The second is to use footprint to check the tasks order within the operation. Finally, we proposed a method on how to utilize the gap to improve the IoT service.

articleTitle: A method to discover spots from Twitter for tour miner
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: Nowadays huge travel records are accumulated in SNS. It has various user experiences however there exists few study to utilize them to plan tours. We proposed a method to discover spots. We also implemented it as a system. Our system collects geocoded tweets from Twitter and store them in a database automatically. When we input a keyword to the system, it gathers tweet about the keyword from the database, discovers spots by clustering geocode.

articleTitle: Constructing wireless sensor network interconnection system with three-dimensional self-organization mechanism
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: Self-organization mechanism is very useful for wireless sensor networks with short transmission range and multi-hop routing. Many researchers have proposed a number of self-organizing algorithms for different fields and different wireless network technologies. However, most of the researches focus on the self-organization mechanism working in two-dimensional field spaces and are very rare for three-dimensional field spaces. This paper adopts a cross-layer judgment scheme to design a three-dimensional self-organization mechanism for wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: A RPL-based self-organization mechanism for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: Based on ZigBee IP network technology and RPL routing protocol, this paper proposes a new self-organization mechanism of active RPL. For a wireless sensor network system with short transmission range and multi-hop routing, the proposed mechanism possesses the features of simple establishing procedure, low memory requirement, low power consumption, and low overhead of control frames. Using the self-organization mechanism in a spatial field environment, an interconnection system of wireless sensor network with tree-based architecture can be fast and autonomously constructed to form a wireless infrastructure for IOT.

articleTitle: Design of a fast number theoretical transform engine for fully homomorphic encryption
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: The high cost of large integer multiplication has become a major restrictive factor of fully homomorphic encryption. In this paper, a radix-32 ping-pong number theoretical transform (NTT) algorithm is applied to accelerate large integer multiplication. Based on the algorithm, we accomplish the design of a fast 32k-point NTT Engine for FHE. Implementation results on FPGA show that our work is able to compute 32k-point NTT in 0.056 milliseconds at the cost of 211k ALUTs and 132k registers, which outperforms the current competitors.

articleTitle: Audio analysis using edge computing for road side assistance systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics (ISCE)
abstract: Although Cloud Computing remains de-facto solution for IoT data processing, Edge Computing (EC) has started to gain its ground. EC systems are closer to devices generating various data types (audio, video, text etc.) and have capabilities to provide quick data validation and analysis. This paper explores one such application of EC for audio analysis in road side assistance services. A noise cancellation algorithm running in the EC system is described. A prototype of the overall scenario is developed and reported.
